Title: A few bug fixes
Body:
# Changed
- Changed: The rating prompt will only be shown when the series is complete or cancelled

# Fixed
- Fixed: Fixed dashboard streams loaded with an offset (develop)
- Fixed: Fixed search results taking fake volumes/chapters into account when displaying series size (develop)
- Fixed: Fixed the manga reader not always correctly closing when dismissing the rating modal (develop)
- Fixed: Fixed some forms across the web app not working (develop)
- Fixed: Fixed OnDeckProgressDays and OnDeckUpdateDays for users created in the last nightly (develop)
- Fixed: Fixed matched series page loading (develop)
- Fixed: Fixed some buttons in the CBL import modal not working
- Fixed: Fixed a wrong log message when syncing users from OIDC
- Fixed: Fixed sometimes not being able to delete users under very specific circumstances
- Fixed: Likely fixed the book reader theme being overwritten by theme updates due to token refreshes (Closes #4942)
- Fixed: Fix incorrect return type for /api/Library/delete-multiple (Closes #4940)
